name: Tiramisu
source:
Head maid and the most dependable one.

Actually, she's Urara's older sister—doll-like in appearance, but despite her looks, she's also a hard worker.

An older sister working as a maid? Is this some daytime soap opera plot twist?"

[From [url=http://www.ole-m.net/products/senpai/chara/chara.htmll] official site[/url]]
